invariants: A learning alert alone can create only NEEDS_REPRODUCTION.
READY_FOR_REPAIR requires VERIFIED failure evidence, reproduction steps, evidence references and a concrete regression-test requirement.
Sensitive-material or benchmark-contaminated failures are BLOCKED.
Repair targets may not include protected governance/workflow/provider/build-state surfaces in v1.
Repair implementation must use the Step 16 isolated factory path on REPO-008.
A factory candidate must be independently verified and PR_OPEN before held-out evaluation begins.
Held-out evaluator must differ from the builder and use exact candidate commit/diff identity.
Independent auditor must differ from both builder and held-out evaluator.
Canary must report zero regressions and zero authority violations.
PROMOTION_ELIGIBLE is not promotion and still requires INTEGRATOR_APPROVAL.
No function in the Step 17 engine merges, deploys, changes default branches or promotes globally.
